title: Edit form
description: Edit one object on one screen without losing entered values when validation or saving fails.

details.purpose: The user changes a value, understands whether it was saved, and can recover from a failure without retyping.

regions.content: h1 names the object; one-sentence purpose.
Save result (success or failure) as a persistent Alert above the fields, inside the form card.
One FormField per value; validation errors render on the field.
Inline row at the end of the form: one primary submit (保存), lower-emphasis secondary actions (outline or ghost).

layout.narrow: Below 768px: single column, Card padding 16px, actions wrap and remain reachable without horizontal scrolling.
layout.wide: Content column limited to a readable width (about 640px) inside the 1280px page; same reading order.

states.invalid: Field error via FormField.error; focus returns to the first invalid field; no toast-only error.
states.pending: Submit Button uses loading; repeated activation sends one request; entered values stay visible.
states.success: success Alert states what was saved; the form keeps the saved value.
states.server-error: danger Alert says the value was not saved and offers a retry; the edited value is preserved.

details.exclusions: Multi-step wizards, autosave, and optimistic updates need their own pattern.
